Quick Commerce Companies Face Rising Costs

Quick commerce companies are experiencing increased operational costs as they transition their dark stores into mini fulfillment centers. This shift is driven by the need to manage expenses in the quick commerce sector. DMart's 'slow e-commerce' strategy is presented as a potential alternative that could prove more sustainable in the long run.
